hooks.command:
bash -c '
CMD=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command" 2>/dev/null)
echo "$CMD" | grep -q "git push" || exit 0

# 방금 push한 run이 등록될 때까지 최대 15초 대기
for i in $(seq 1 5); do
  RUN_ID=$(gh run list --limit 1 --json databaseId,createdAt -q ".[0].databaseId" 2>/dev/null)
  [ -n "$RUN_ID" ] && break
  sleep 3
done

if [ -z "$RUN_ID" ]; then
  echo "CI 런을 찾을 수 없습니다."
  exit 2
fi

# CI 완료 대기 (최대 5분)
gh run watch "$RUN_ID" --exit-status >/dev/null 2>&1
CI_EXIT=$?

SUMMARY=$(gh run list --limit 1 --json status,conclusion,name,headBranch \
  -q ".[0] | \"[\(.name)] \(.conclusion // .status) (\(.headBranch))\"" 2>/dev/null)

if [ $CI_EXIT -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "CI ✅ PASSED — $SUMMARY"
else
  echo "CI ❌ FAILED — $SUMMARY"
  echo ""
  echo "--- 오류 로그 ---"
  gh run view "$RUN_ID" --log-failed 2>/dev/null \
    | grep -E "error|Error|Type error|Failed to compile|Cannot find" \
    | grep -v "^Frontend lint" | head -15
fi
exit 2
'
